hero_line: Jun reads Guardian music dispatches to keep every membership and brand pitch rooted in culture.

entries.title: Breakout indie band Westside Cowboy on rejecting tech and loving imperfection: ‘We’re not hermits!’
entries.summary: Despite their fast rise, the Manchester indie-pop band are happily going at their own pace. But what – if anything – did they learn from the advice of Duran Duran’s Simon Le Bon?

entries.title: ‘So many people say things about my appearance – it’s not normal’: Jorja Smith on burnout, body-shaming and finding freedom
entries.summary: Being recognised by the Brits, Grammys and Drake made the singer one of British music’s most famous names – and also left her exhausted. Now, after decompressing in her home town she returns with a record made for raving

entries.title: Post your questions for Beck
entries.summary: The genre-hopping hitmaker’s new album fingerpicks the same melancholy heartstrings as Sea Change. You can ask him anything in our upcoming reader interview

entries.title: Four blokes and a zebra crossing: the banality and beauty of the Beatles’ Abbey Road cover
entries.summary: Much-copied and parodied picture captures dynamic between the individuals and the band with eerie perfection
